name: @lumo-ui/website
description: lumo-ui.com: the Lumo UI website and its on-site technical documentation, a static export that consumes the workspace package and is graded by its own gate.

scripts.dev: node scripts/prepare-private-fonts.mjs && node scripts/check-site-assets.mjs && node scripts/check-public-contract.mjs && next dev --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 3113
scripts.build: node scripts/prepare-private-fonts.mjs && node scripts/check-site-assets.mjs && node scripts/check-public-contract.mjs && node scripts/check-public-docs.mjs && next build && node scripts/own-static-shells.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:gate && pnpm build && pnpm gate
